newsitem.title: USA: UAW, Ford recess labor talks until Monday morning.
newsitem.headline: UAW, Ford recess labor talks until Monday morning.

text.p: Negotiators for the United Auto Workers and Ford Motor Co. F decided to break off talks for the night on Sunday evening after failing to reach a tentative labor contract agreement, union and Ford officials said.
Negotiations are expected to resume on Monday morning at 8 a.m. EDT (1200 GMT) and production at Ford's U.S. plants is expected to proceed without disruption, the automaker said.
:UAW, Ford recess labor talks until Monday morning
UAW sources said the two sides were still at odds over economic, job and outsourcing issues.
"I think things are proceeding well. People just need some rest," said Ford spokesman Jon Harmon.
In a statement Ford said its negotiating teams "will return at 8 in the morning and have agreed that they will continue at that time with the intention of reaching an agreement."
"Our negotiating teams have worked steadily and effectively almost the entire weekend, including through Saturday night."
